title: xdrip doesn't connect to blucon at all.
symptom: xDrip does not connect to Blucon at all. It connects via Bluetooth and the pass is entered, but it never gets 2 readings from the transmitter. Status is 'bonded', but disconnected or connected on 'connection status'. Changing many settings has not improved the situation.
evidence_quote: changed batteries, changed libre sensor, reinstalled xdrip and set all advised settings, however it doesn't collect any data. it connects via BT, i enter pass but it never gets 2 readings from transmitter.
